description: Type Cloud SQL's 403 'The caller does not have permission' on backup get/update/delete. Observed live 2026-09-29: getBackupBackups on a nonexistent backup uid answers it with a caller that can list backups. A distinct tag lets callers confirm absence via listBackupsBackups instead of treating every Forbidden as missing.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Cloud SQL answered HTTP 403 PERMISSION_DENIED 'The caller does not have permission' for a backup. It returns exactly this for a backup uid that does not exist, and also when the caller lacks permission, so confirm with listBackupsBackups before treating the backup as missing.

message.includes: The caller does not have permission
